notes: Two-column split banner (div.hero-half Left + Right), each a repeated block with image background, counter overline (top-left), copy stack (eyebrow, Display H1 title, description, secondary outline button), bottom-anchored. Same Essential vars resolve to two schemes by half: left on light image uses dark text (Essential/Foreground Heading #1e1b18, Essential/Foreground #2a2620, Secondary button/Text #1e1b18); right on dark image uses light text (#fffefd / #faf7f2 / #faf7f2) -> multiScheme. Secondary button is transparent bg with 1px border in the text color, square corners (radius 0), 48px tall, px-32 py-16, uppercase Label/Overline Bold. Button is a library Atom instance (Button, node 21:10, variants Style Primary/Secondary x State Default/Hover). Desktop frame 1680x782. No mobile variant returned by this node. No carousel/marquee/sticky behavior.
